value.rationale: A canonical free conic-line family displays three distinct exact polar degrees under prime reduction and a drastic failure of dominance in p=2 without a change in reduced component-incidence geometry. The p|m branch has a sharp coefficient-dependent inseparability boundary with explicit squarefree examples on both sides. These are natural and broadly parameterized arithmetic invariants of the published geometric family, not a numerical sample or routine normalization check.
